name: Berkeley Lab Director's Apprenticeship Program (BLDAP)
what_you_do: Six week in-person STEM program with machine learning and data science projects, computer science coursework and talks with scientists.
who_can_apply: Grades 10 and 11. Public school students in Alameda, San Francisco and Contra Costa counties are prioritized; nearby counties are encouraged to apply. In person at Berkeley Lab at least 4 days a week for 6 weeks.
pay_detail: Not stated on the page (no stipend listed)
duration: June 16 to July 24, 2026 (6 weeks, 4 days a week)
deadline_text: 2026 applications opened Feb 2, 2026 and are now closed (the page gives no closing date). 2027 not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the Berkeley Lab K-12 program page when it opens (the 2026 application ran through apply.mykaleidoscope.com).
notes: Whether students are paid is not stated. Finishing students can join later workshops and possible lab internships in following summers.
